articles.summary: Independent Bank was awarded 4 Affordable Housing Program grants this year from the Federal Home Loan Bank of Indianapolis (FHLBI), the most in Michigan.
articles.title: Independent Bank Awarded Most Affordable Housing Grants Approved in Michigan for 2025
